name: Engraved study paired with a word
looks: On a warm paper-white ground, a thick comma-like glyph sits above a small accent dot; cut to a dense tangle of calligraphic flourish lines, then to a short serif word with its own small accent dot, an antique engraving of a scholar at a desk with a rhino study pinned above him resting quietly beside the word.
build: Each element arrives on a plain fast fade/lift (`y:6-10px -> 0`, 200-300ms) and holds; the engraving is placed directly on the page, no frame or shadow, desaturated to near-monochrome against the warm ground. The accent dot is the one recurring coloured mark across every card.
sound: Near silence, a very soft paper-texture hiss under the holds.
prompt: On a warm paper-coloured ground, pair a short serif word with a small accent dot and a piece of antique engraving artwork placed directly on the page with no frame, letting each element arrive on a plain quick fade so the sequence reads as a considered, literary opening rather than a flashy one.
